name: Andaman & Nicobar Islands Scheme for Health Insurance
description: The Health Insurance (ANISHI) shall provide cashless treatment upto Rupees 5 Lakhs per patients per illness which include indoor and outdoor treatments.

name: Death Benefit (ANBOCWWB)
description: The scheme provides financial assistance to the nominees or dependents of workers engaged in Building or Other Construction Works in Andaman & Nicobar Islands in the event of their natural or accidental death.

name: Disability Assistance (ANBOCWWB)
description: The scheme provides financial assistance to registered construction workers who become disabled due to an accident during the course of their employment on the production of a certificate from competent medical authorities in respect of the percentage of disability.

name: Dulari Scheme
description: The DULARI Scheme was implemented by the Directorate of Health Services in the Andaman and Nicobar Islands to provide incentives for newborn baby girls and to the girl children who pass Classes VIII, X, and XII.
category: Education & Learning, Health & Wellness, Women and Child

name: Educational Assistance (ANBOCWWB)
description: This scheme provides educational assistance to the son or daughter of a registered construction worker who is studying in any class from Class I to Post Graduate Level/Professional Course.

name: Funeral Assistance (ANBOCWWB)
description: The scheme provides financial assistance to the nominees or dependents of deceased workers who were registered under the A&N Islands Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board, towards their funeral expenses.

name: Incentive Scheme For The Electricity Consumers Under Various Categories In Andaman & Nicobar Islands

name: Marriage Assistance (ANBOCWWB)
description: Under this scheme, registered construction workers will receive a financial allowance to cover either their own marriage expenses or those of their two dependent children.

name: Maternity Benefit (ANBOCWWB)
description: The scheme offers maternity benefits to female employees registered as beneficiaries for one year during their maternity period. Additionally, male employees, registered for a year, with wives aged 19 or older and not beneficiaries, are also eligible for maternity benefits.
category: Social welfare & Empowerment, Women and Child

name: Medical Assistance (ANBOCWWB)
description: The scheme provides medical assistance to the Building & Other Construction Workers, who are registered under the A&N Islands Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board, and his/her dependents' family members during hospitalization due to accident or illness.

name: Pension Benefit (ANBOCWWB)
description: Under this scheme, pension shall be provided to the Building and Other Construction Workers who are registered under the A&N Islands Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board upon attaining the age of 55 years.
category: Banking,Financial Services and Insurance, Social welfare & Empowerment

description: The scheme “The Andaman & Nicobar Islands Allowance to Destitute Women Scheme” is implemented by the Directorate of Social Welfare, Union Territory of Andaman and Nicobar Islands to provide financial assistance to the poorest and destitute women in the Andaman and Nicobar…

name: The Andaman & Nicobar Islands Disability Allowance Scheme
description: The objective of the scheme is to provide financial assistance to the differently able unemployed persons with 40% disability or more in the Andaman and Nicobar Islands.

name: The Andaman & Nicobar Islands Old Age Assistance Scheme
description: The aim of the scheme is to provide social security by way of financial assistance to destitute, senior citizens who are without any means of subsistence and having no one to give financial support to them for their livelihood.

name: The Andaman & Nicobar Islands Widow Pension Scheme
description: The scheme “The Andaman & Nicobar Islands Widow Pension Scheme” is implemented by the Directorate of Social Welfare, Union Territory of Andaman and Nicobar Islands to provide financial assistance to poor and destitute widows in the Andaman and Nicobar Islands.
